body:
**Agent review** of the whole pull request, at `b12d760`: all 47 files reviewed.

8 finding(s): 3 to fix, 5 to consider; 8 on their lines. Reply in a comment's thread to answer it.

### Summary

**Batch 1 of 6.** Part 1 of 6. Prepare is now Export, with redirects so the old `/prepare` links keep working. Email becomes a destination that shares chat's preset, and the new `destination` override in `usePrepareCopy` keeps the progress and ready cards saying Email. `destinationOfPreset("balanced")` still returns chat because `DESTINATION_IDS` puts chat before email. The page's hooks run in the same order whatever it shows, and the keyboard rules leave buttons, fields and the picker dialog alone. One small suggestion: disable \"Pick from Library\" in the drop zone while an import is running, like \"Browse files\" already is.

**Batch 2 of 6.** I found no blockers and nothing that needs a fix in this part. The deleted `destination-detail.tsx` is replaced by `export-stage.tsx`. The GitHub limit logic agrees with `planCopy`, where `underGithubFreeLimit` comes from `githubPlans().free` (10 MB, `destinations.ts:203`). `destinationOfPreset` covers every preset. In `library-page.tsx`, the removed imports leave no dangling uses, and `Button` is still used. I have three suggestions you can take or leave: the GitHub size bar's accessible label leaves out the fits/over verdict, the picker's dialog doesn't manage focus, and the in-progress row in Recent exports puts the video title where the finished rows show the destination name.

**Batch 3 of 6.** I found nothing to flag in the seven files of part 3.

- **Deleted Prepare files:** nothing in `src` still imports the removed Prepare page, its destination list or its drop zone, or the Library's import drop zone. `isPrimaryEnter` now lives in `export-page.tsx`.
- **Sidebar:** the Export item matches both `/export` and `/export/:assetId`. Its badge counts the copy being made plus finished copies the user hasn't seen. Opening Export or the Library clears the finished ones. The `export.railBadge` message says "in progress or ready", which matches that count.
- **`use-file-drop.test.tsx`:** it keeps the deleted drop-zone test's checks for `useFileDrop` and drops the ones that were about the component.
- **`destinations.test.ts`:** it matches `destinations.ts`. Email shares chat's `balanced` preset, and `destinationOfPreset("balanced")` still returns "chat".

**Batch 4 of 6.** This part holds the new `export-page.test.tsx` and updates to the Library and Library detail tests. The Export page tests cover the picked-destination flow, keyboard handling, the redirects from the old Prepare URLs, and importing by drag and drop. The Library detail changes swap `/prepare` for `/export` and are correct. I found one problem: the new Library test that says a dropped video isn't taken passes no matter what the page does. It runs with the default empty `pathForFile` stub, so `importVideoFiles` is never called either way.

**Batch 5 of 6.** Part 5 has one test that doesn't check what its name says and one gap in test coverage, both in sidebar.test.tsx. The stylesheets only use CSS variables that are defined in packages/tokens or base.css. The class names used by export-page.tsx exist in the stylesheet. The badge strings the sidebar test expects match en.json.

**Batch 6 of 6.** I reviewed all 11 files in part 6 and found one problem: a stale comment in `library-page.module.css` at line 108.\n\n**The finding:** the `.importZone` rule was deleted, but the comment above it about the \"Drop a video here\" strip was left behind. It now sits on top of the `.stickyBar` comment and reads as if it describes the sticky bar. Deleting that one line fixes it.\n\n**What checked out:**\n- **Stylesheets:** every class `export-stage.tsx` uses still exists in its stylesheet, and the new `data-tone` selectors match the attributes the component sets.\n- **Removed strings:** none of the deleted message keys (`library.importVideo`, the `importDrop*` keys, `prepare.prepareAVideo`) is referenced anywhere in the renderer any more.\n- **Scrolling:** the stage comment says it scrolls on its own. `.stage` has no overflow rule itself, but the scroll container in `export-page.module.css` (line 23) provides it.\n- **`routes.ts`:** it only adds string constants and comments, so it stays free of value imports from workspace packages.\n- **Messages and docs:** the English and Spanish `export` namespaces have the same keys, and the backlog doc and index entry match what the change does.

> [!IMPORTANT] > Export now stays on screen after an export starts, but it never re-reads the Library when that copy finishes. The card never turns "Ready", and pressing Enter again encodes the same copy a second time. Details inline. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed the whole PR: the new Export screen, its rail entry and redirects, the Email destination, and the Library losing its import door. - **Export screen**: `pages/export/` replaces `pages/prepare/`. It has a fixed header with the video and "Change video", a stage for the picked destination, and a fixed row of seven destination cards. Enter and ←/→ work across the whole screen. - **Routes**: `/export/:assetId` and `/export` are new. `/prepare*` redirects to them and keeps `?to=`. `preparePath()` / `prepareNewPath()` now return Export URLs. - **Rail badge**: the new EXPORT item under Editor counts the export that is running plus finished copies not seen yet. Opening Export or the Library clears it. - **Email destination**: `email` uses the same `balanced` preset as chat. `PrepareCopyInput.destination` passes it to the runner job. - **Library**: the import button, the drop strip and the window-wide drop are gone. `ImportDropZone` is deleted and its `useFileDrop` coverage moved to `use-file-drop.test.tsx`. - **No-video state**: a drop zone, the Library picker, and "Recent exports" (the running export plus the newest finished copies).   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/467?action=fix&review_id=5720296552) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/467?action=fix-approved&review_id=5720296552) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41153840590/job/124396168587) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)

> ✅ No new issues found. The open thread about Export not re-reading the Library is still open here, because the fix landed on #471 (`3f7a3557`) higher up the stack. It will close when that lands. **Reviewed changes** Since `b12d760`, two merges of `feature/niw2-587-prepare-drop-zone` came in. Almost all of the delta comes from the base branch: workspaces, vault reconcile and the webcam track. Two parts belong to this PR: - **Export's "Ready" uses the webcam-aware fingerprint**: `ExportScreen` now looks up reusable copies with `prepareFingerprint(prepareScene(video, probe))` instead of `WHOLE_RECORDING_FINGERPRINT`. This matches what `usePrepareCopy.start` writes. For a take with a webcam, an older copy without the face is no longer offered as "Ready". - **Added a webcam composition test**: `export-page.test.tsx` checks that a take with a webcam passes `webcamTrack` and composes the face at `recordedLayout`. It also checks that the copy is fingerprinted `whole:`, not `whole`. - **Kept the base's Library additions in the merge**: `library-page.tsx` still has `ReconcileBanner` and `WorkspaceNotConnectedNotice`, and the drop strip removed by this PR stays removed.   ｜ [Fix it ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-record/467?action=fix&review_id=5723844519) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/41221341310/job/124596359291) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
